Based on the provided information, the calibration offset test (TS-4471) failed at -20°C with a mean value of 1.472 mV, which is outside the limit of -1.0 to 1.0 mV. The mean value increased by 1.147 mV from the previous build (32) to the current build (33). The changelog for build 33 includes updates to the temperature compensation table and changes to the touch filter and haptics.

The temperature compensation table update is the most relevant change, as it directly affects the calibration offset test. The previous incident (RDAR-120455) involved a similar update to the temperature compensation table, but it did not cause a regression at the -20°C temperature. The root cause in that case was that the update only adjusted the hot range above 50°C, so it did not affect the -20°C measurements.

Given this evidence, the failure is likely due to the update to the temperature compensation table, even though it did not cause a regression in the previous incident.

LIKELY CAUSE: firmware/thermal: update temperature compensation table
CONFIDENCE: medium
